title: Representative Tom Weber announces Oct. 7 traveling office hours at Lake Villa Library
text:

Representative Tom Weber announces Oct. 7 traveling office hours at Lake Villa Library
Representative Tom Weber’s staff will hold traveling office hours on Oct. 7 at Lake Villa Library in Lindenhurst from 10 a.m. to noon. The event is open for walk-ins seeking assistance with state issues or services.
Representative Tom Weber’s staff will be available to meet with constituents to answer questions and provide assistance with state issues, programs, and services at the Lake Villa Library in Lindenhurst on Oct. 7. Walk-ins are encouraged, and no appointment is necessary, according to an announcement on Oct. 1.
The traveling office hours will take place from 10 a.m. to 12 p.m. at the Lake Villa Library located at 140 N Munn Rd, Lindenhurst, IL 60046. Residents are invited to attend during this time frame for support or information related to state government matters.
Those seeking additional information can call 847-629-5439 with any questions regarding the event.
Weber, a Republican, was elected to the Illinois State House in 2019 to represent the state's 64th House District, replacing previous state representative Barbara Wheeler, according to Representative Tom Weber's official website.
